title: Affine radicial preparation construction
statement: Let X be affine and f:X→T locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let V be an affine open containing the image of f, and η a generic point of T whose fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There exist an affine open U containing η, integral affine S [def-pc-integral-scheme], reduced affine Y [def-pc-reduced-scheme], a universal homeomorphism q:S→U [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism], and a locally finite type map g:Y→S. There is a generic point η′ of S mapping to η whose g-fibre is geometrically reduced. Moreover there is a universal homeomorphism h:Y→X×_T S [def-pc-fibre-product], where S→T is q followed by the inclusion of U, and h followed by the pullback projection equals g. No fibre-irreducibility equivalence or final flatness is asserted.

proof.text: Geometric irreducibility gives a nonempty generic fibre, hence eta lies in V. Apply reduced flat affine preparation to obtain U, S0, Z and the universal homeomorphism h0 onto the original pullback.

Use universal-homeomorphism fibre comparison to transfer geometric irreducibility to the generic fibre of the reduced flat family over S0. Apply radicial reduced flat generic fibre construction to obtain S and q1, and geometric reducedness of the canonical reduced pullback.

Set Y to the actual reduction of Z times_S0 S; its reduction map a is a universal homeomorphism. The pullback of h0 is a universal homeomorphism. Compose a with it and the two pullback pasting isomorphisms to construct h:Y to X times_T S. The projection identities prove h followed by the second projection equals g. Composition gives q=q1 followed by q0 and the generic-point equalities compose. Affineness, reducedness and local finite type follow from the reduction construction and base-change instances.

proof_origin.note: The construction is assembled from the two new intermediate construction statements and the existing fibre-comparison and reduction universal-homeomorphism declarations.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_radicial_preparation_construction
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (V : T.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (himage : Set.range f ⊆ V)
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens), η ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ (S Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : S ⟶ U.toScheme) (g : Y ⟶ S),
        IsAffine S ∧ IsIntegral S ∧ IsAffine Y ∧ IsReduced Y ∧
        IsUniversalHomeomorphism q ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType g ∧
        ∃ η' : S, IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ ∧ (q ≫ U.ι) η' = η ∧
          GeometricallyReduced (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η') ∧
          ∃ h : Y ⟶ pullback f (q ≫ U.ι),
            IsUniversalHomeomorphism h ∧ h ≫ pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι) = g
